summary.text: Joe Orgeron is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 54, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson and Lafourche parishes. First elected in 2020, Joe Orgeron serves as vice chair of the Natural Resources and Environment Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Joe Orgeron's occupation as principal of Orgeron Development, LLC, with a degree from South Lafourche High School (1984), a B.S. in physics from Nicholls State University (1988), and an M.S. (1990) and Ph.D. (1993) in physics from the University of Texas.

The House page lists Joe Orgeron's committee assignments as Natural Resources and Environment (vice chair), Judiciary, Ways and Means, and Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
